task.title: Complete daemon/agency foundation for parallel refactor
task.summary: Make CodeWiki daemon/agency safe to use for later parallel refactor work by aligning traces, runtime scheduling, gate diagnostics, and worktree/publisher coordination.

goal.outcome: Daemon/agency can safely schedule bounded, non-overlapping refactor work from graph/trace/gate refs after this task passes.
acceptance: Telemetry trace and ArtifactRef source contracts exist or compatibility helpers normalize legacy build/gate refs for daemon use.
Runtime job/run types and automation-readiness use canonical loops plus trace_refs/gate_refs/git_refs while preserving legacy job compatibility.
Gate preflight/verdict output exposes structured diagnostics/findings/remediation usable by daemon stop reasons.
Worktree, artifact-status, and publisher paths block unsafe overlapping writes and record exact branch/head/tree/digest refs.
.tmp-worktrees is safely removed after dirty/claim checks or documented/ignored as local scratch with no production semantics.
Targeted runtime, agency, gateway, worktree, publisher, and package smoke tests pass.
non_goals: Do not run broad autonomous refactor work before this task closes.
Do not migrate all source roots to loop-first layout in this task.
Do not migrate every existing .codewiki/builds or .codewiki/validation artifact in this task.
Do not publish or push remote changes.
verification: git worktree list --porcelain and dirty-state checks

delta.desired:
Additional outcome: Daemon/runtime work selection uses the three-loop trace model and stops with exact gate/remediation blockers instead of legacy loop states.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Gate reports and preflight results use canonical diagnostics/findings/remediation structure for the three loop exit gates.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Parallel write work has safe scoped leases, role worktrees, publisher serialization, and cleanup guidance before broad refactor automation starts.
